title: Bach — Menuet in G minor, BWV Anh. 115

editionNotes: LilyPond \tempo 4 = 140 in 3/4, G minor. Two bar-checked \repeat volta 2 blocks of 16 bars each (printed 32; performed 64). Mutopia MIDI does not unfold them.
Sibling of anna-magdalena-04: same typesetter, same form, minor key. The pair isolates key reading from everything else in the gate.
pdf.sha256 pins the Mutopia letter PDF (1 page). Do not embed document UUIDs.
Six printed ornament signs (4 \prall + 2 \mordent) at 2 added notes each: expectedExtraNotes 12. Cleffy realizes them (src/ornaments.ts), LilyPond's MIDI does not.
